raw_segments.text: He rustled one of the letters and, looking straight in my face, said,
Somebody had been writing to him about me.
These special recommendations were turning up again.
The volume of tone he emitted without effort, almost without the trouble of moving his lips,
It was grave, profound, vibrating, while the man did not seem capable of a whisper.
However, he had enough strength in him,
factitious, no doubt, to very nearly make an end of us as you shall hear directly.
